meta.label: control-baseline-7d3a28a
meta.dataKind: mock/synthetic: injected fake clients, local fake executables and generated files; no provider calls
meta.notes: Each repetition runs in a fresh Node process, sequentially; workloads never run concurrently with each other.

workloads.description: Long-lived sandbox with increasing operations (retained receipts, heap, RSS) and parallel required persistence with delayed or failing A.

cases.name: long-lived-best-effort
cases.description: 20k sequential exec operations on one live sandbox, receipts on, best-effort persistence to a non-retaining store.

cases.name: long-lived-required
cases.description: Same as long-lived-best-effort with receiptPersistence required.

cases.name: parallel-required-delayed-a
cases.description: A and B concurrent; A receipt write delayed 50 ms; B write immediate. Measures B latency.

cases.name: parallel-required-failing-a
cases.description: A and B concurrent; A receipt write fails after 5 ms. Measures whether B is rejected by A's failure.

cases.name: required-inflight-bookkeeping
cases.description: 50k sequential required-persistence exec operations with an immediate store; heap growth per operation after GC.

workloads.description: Large artifact under a tiny limit (bytes read, peak memory), large artifact within budget and many small files (inventory/hash parity).

cases.name: large-file-tiny-limit
cases.description: One 16 MiB file, maxBytes 1. Intended: the file is not read in full.

cases.name: large-file-within-budget
cases.description: One 48 MiB file under the default budget. Hash must equal an independent sha256.

cases.name: many-small-files
cases.description: 1000 files of 4 KiB across 20 directories (the default maxFiles), default budgets. Inventory digest is the parity check.

workloads.description: Repeated provider calls per adapter instance: SDK client construction count, cold and warm call timing (mock send).

cases.name: ec2-owned-client
cases.description: 50 sequential ec2 operations through one adapter instance with an adapter-owned SDK client.

cases.name: ec2-injected-client
cases.description: 50 operations with an injected client. Ownership check: the adapter must use it and construct no SDK client.

cases.name: ecs-owned-client
cases.description: 50 sequential ecs operations through one adapter instance with an adapter-owned SDK client.

cases.name: ecs-injected-client
cases.description: 50 operations with an injected client. Ownership check: the adapter must use it and construct no SDK client.

cases.name: lambda-owned-client
cases.description: 50 sequential lambda operations through one adapter instance with an adapter-owned SDK client.

cases.name: lambda-injected-client
cases.description: 50 operations with an injected client. Ownership check: the adapter must use it and construct no SDK client.

workloads.description: Finite, fragmented, malformed, endless and idle runtime log bodies: completion, cancellation, memory and caps (mock fetch).

cases.name: finite-array
cases.description: JSON array body with 2000 records, limit 100.

cases.name: ndjson-fragmented
cases.description: NDJSON body, 2000 records, delivered in seeded fragments of 1..64 bytes, then closed. limit 100.

cases.name: ndjson-malformed
cases.description: NDJSON body with one truncated record in the middle, fragmented, then closed.

error.message.value: Unterminated string in JSON at position 28 (line 1 column 29)

cases.name: endless-limit-10
cases.description: Never-closing NDJSON body emitting as fast as pulled (capped at 64 MiB emitted), limit 10, 3 s watchdog.

cases.name: idle-limit-10
cases.description: One record then an open, silent body. limit 10, 3 s watchdog.

workloads.description: Many pods and containers: max outstanding log requests, elapsed time, global order, newest-limit selection and secret redaction (mock CoreV1 client).

cases.name: 40-pods-3-containers-all
cases.description: 40 pods x 3 containers, 25 lines each, 5 ms per log request, no limit.

cases.name: 40-pods-3-containers-limit-20
cases.description: Same cluster, limit 20: must be the 20 globally newest lines regardless of provider pod order.

workloads.description: CLI cold start: fresh Node process per sample, wall time and peak RSS; stdout digest is the help/report parity check.

cases.name: help
cases.description: capsule --help with empty HOME and no credentials, 10 fresh processes per repetition.

cases.name: capabilities-json
cases.description: capsule capabilities --json with empty HOME and no credentials, 10 fresh processes per repetition.

cases.name: preset-list-json
cases.description: capsule preset list --json with empty HOME and no credentials, 10 fresh processes per repetition.

cases.name: completion-bash
cases.description: capsule completion bash with empty HOME and no credentials, 10 fresh processes per repetition.

workloads.description: Docker exec stdout capture size, truncation visibility and peak RSS with a local fake docker binary.

cases.name: stdout-10MiB
cases.description: 10 MiB of 100-byte lines on stdout.

cases.name: stdout-100MiB
cases.description: 100 MiB of 100-byte lines on stdout.

workloads.description: JSONL receipt store readAll over a large synthetic file: elapsed, peak RSS and corruption line location.

cases.name: read-50k
cases.description: 50k receipts, valid file.

cases.name: corrupt-line-25000
cases.description: 50k receipts with line 25000 truncated; the error must name the line.
